name: Popcorn
description: Movies are long-form audiovisual works, yet recommender benchmarks often rely on trailers, thumbnails, or metadata. These sources differ in semantics and scalability: full movies preserve consumption-level evidence, trailers concentrate promotional highlights, and thumbnails provide sparse but catalog-scale visual signals. We present Popcorn, a configurable benchmark for visual evidence in multimodal movie recommendation, combining title-aligned full-movie/trailer embeddings with MovieLens-linked thumbnail features encoded by modern visual and vision-language models.
